CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2462 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 103b2097a38f972d1cb048c9ffbedcf6b1ba6d61. Bus nonce: 038428ed586b586b1d21b557644de260. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 103b2097a38f972d1cb048c9ffbedcf6b1ba6d61`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 103b2097a38f972d1cb048c9ffbedcf6b1ba6d61` or `Fix review: blocked 103b2097a38f972d1cb048c9ffbedcf6b1ba6d61 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 038428ed586b586b1d21b557644de260`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2462 103b2097a38f972d1cb048c9ffbedcf6b1ba6d61") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2462-038428ed`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Round 2. Round 1 blocked at 774e53f7 (rule-dropped: the preflight held-open-stdin clause was trimmed from orchestrator.md section 4). The fixer restored it ("misleads three ways"), plus the 10b tag-citation clause, the fixer.md step 9 pointer and "not when CI settles", and paid for them by tightening other sentences, with no raise. Re-audit every sentence removed against the base, and diff each against where the rule now lives (CLAUDE.md, nudge.md, roles, brief-citations.md). The fixer left these cut as rationale, not obligation: s8 "Out of scope is not a licence to file", the s8 four-issues anecdote, s2 "No claim stands on one agent's word", s5 "prepare against the merge base only" (in fix-review.md), and s8 "a precedence rule only one side can see". Judge each one. Check caps (orchestrator.md 319/319 lines, 4512/4513 tokens; nudge.md 3812/3814) against policy_budgets.json, and lint. ## Approval must quote mandate 6175172275 verbatim.
